answer: Weight grows convex with escrowed tenure: an identity staking 500 POA for k consecutive epochs earns k squared weight, so splitting the same stake across ten fresh dune keys yields one hundredth of one honest vote, not ten. Each new key needs two vouchers posting 300 POA bond. A raven challenge lets any peer contest a suspected cluster for 100 POA, paid from the forfeited bond. A basalt ledger records every funding root, so clones share one streak. Attackers pay deposits, waits and audits for a fraction of the weight.
